issue.body:
Since https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/135679 was fixed, we can re-enable INLINE STATS generative tests.

Unfortunately, there is a new failure, see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/136797, so I had to add an exception for that (that means `PostOptimizationPhasePlanVerifier` checks won't be considered by generative tests)
